_comment: Machine-readable motion configuration. Pattern CATEGORIES below are the reusable mechanism (tag A, see blueprint/15-responsive-ux-motion-system.md); specific timing/easing VALUES are brand-specific (tag E) and must be chosen fresh per company, never copied from Sanad's own 'calm/understated' values in SANAD-BRAND-REFERENCE.md.

skeleton_shimmer.scope: genuinely-async re-renders only, not general page loads

three_d.notes: Not implemented in the current Sanad codebase — new engineering if selected.

assistant_avatar_motion.notes: The current AI assistant is text-only with no avatar — this is new engineering if a visual character is wanted.

reduced_motion._comment: Keep this mechanism verbatim — it is Core Platform DNA (tag A), not a brand choice.
reduced_motion.note: prefers-reduced-motion must be handled at BOTH the CSS animation/transition level AND the JS timer level (e.g. skip an auto-dismiss timer entirely, not just shorten it) — see blueprint/15 for the WCAG 2.2.1 rationale.
